third_party_evaluations.summary: Expert-level theory + scenario exam validating end-to-end Fortinet Security Fabric design.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced expert: 2, professional: 1. The ordered median is expert. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded end-to-end fabric design, scenario assessment and explicit senior rigor support expert responsibility within Fortinet deployments; a five-year profile and vendor dependence limit broader interpretations.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded end-to-end Security Fabric design, scenario assessment and senior-scope factors support expert platform architecture. The five-year profile and abbreviated logistics leave uncertainty about practical breadth, which I would investigate during hiring.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded end-to-end design scope and five-year profile indicate senior product knowledge. I discount the Expert label because the supplied evidence describes theory and scenarios rather than an extensive practical delivery assessment.
